༄༅/ /sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi gtor zlog khro bo rol pa shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs legs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi gtor zlog khro bo rol pa shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs legs so//

che mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ khro bo rol pa shin tu bsdus pa ni// thod pa'am ni zangs lcags snod nang du// dmar gtor dgu bshams sha khrag ling gas brgyan// steng du khyung btsugs sman raka gtor mchod bsham/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum// sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha tshogs la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba sems can kun don du// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /chos kun stong pa'i ngang nyid las// pad+ma nyi zla dregs pa'i steng*// hūm̐ yig mthing nag yongs gyur las// bdag nyid che mchog he ru ka /mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal// phyag drug rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams// dpal dang dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs// gar dgu'i nyams ldan yum dang 'khril// spyi mgrin 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs// thugs kar rdor sems thugs ka ru// rdo rje hūm̐ dmar sngags kyis bskor// dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed// mgrin par rta mgrin pad+ma dbang*// thugs kar badz+ra he ru ka /lte bar rdo rje gzhon nu che// gsang bar bla med he ru ka /brla g.yas dregs pa kun 'dul rje// g.yon du stobs ldan nag po la// spyi bor bla ma rig 'dzin gsal// lha tshogs kun gyi gnas gsum dang*// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med gyur// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+sha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces bzla 'o// mdun du ma traṃ bsgral pa'i phung po las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang*/ phyi rin po che la nang thod pa skam rlon brtsigs pa'i dbus su nyi zla pad+ma dregs pa'i gdan la/ che mchog he ru ka smug nag zhal nyi shu rtsa gcig /phyag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis na zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bsnams pa/ srid pa'i bya khyung gis dbu brgyan pa/

yum khro mo gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad pa dang zhal sbyor ba la/ che mchog yon tan gyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i shar du badz+ra he ru ka la yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ lhor gshin rje gshed la 'jam dpal sku'i lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ nub tu pad+ma dbang chen la pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang du rdo rje gzhon nu la phur pa phrin las kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ shar lhor bla med he ru ka la ma mo rbod gtong gi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ lho nub tu rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal la bla ma rig 'dzin gyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ nub byang du dregs pa kun 'dul la 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang shar du stobs ldan nag po la dmod pa drag sngags kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ sgo bzhi la sgo ma bzhi/ phyi'i lcags ri la dpal gyi bka' nyan dpal mgon bdun cu'i tshogs dang bcas pa gsal ba'i/ gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gyis mtshan cing ye shes lnga yi dbang bskur bar gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ hūm̐/ rnam dag chos dbyings mnyam nyid las// zhi khro yongs rdzogs skur bzhengs la// srid gsum gdug pa'i tshogs bsgral phyir// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// e h+ye hi sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhrīng hrīng dza dzaḥ sa ma ya ā be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ a ti pū hoḥ pra ti tsa hoḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ hūm̐/ dregs pa lha chen phyogs skyong bsnol ba'i steng*// che mchog la sogs dpal chen khro rgyal tshogs// gar dgu'i tshogs kyis hūm̐ sgra sgrog la bstod// hūm̐/ thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i lha tshogs ni// zhi khro bka' brgyad lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskangs gyur cig /nyams chag 'gal 'khrul thams cad mthol lo bshags// hūm̐/ rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig

/mchod gtor bzhes la phrin las 'grub par mdzod// bka' brgyad bka' yi srung ma thugs dam can// mchod gtor 'di bzhes dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs// dkon mchog bden pas gnod byed dgra dang bgegs// bla srog ling ga 'di la myur du khug /bka' brgyad lha tshogs sras sprul bka' sdod bcas// lcags kyus zungs la phur bus dgra bgegs sgrol// shan pa 'bum gyis sha rus dum bur gtubs// dmar chen khrag gi rgya mtsho bzhes su gsol// dgra bgegs sha khrag dpal chen zhal du bstabs// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor mas thugs dam bskang*// dgra bgegs byad ma gtad do ma shor cig /byad kha rbod gtong sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo// hūm̐/ smug nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// che mchog yon tan lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis// dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa 'di bzhes la// byad ma dgra bgegs gnod pa'i sbyor ba zlog /hūm̐/ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis// dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa 'di bzhes la// byad ma dgra bgegs gnod pa'i sbyor ba zlog /hūm̐/ ser nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis// dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa 'di bzhes la// byad ma dgra bgegs gnod pa'i sbyor ba zlog /hūm̐/ dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis// dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa 'di bzhes la// byad ma dgra bgegs gnod pa'i sbyor ba zlog /hūm̐/ ljang nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// phur pa phrin las lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis// dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa 'di bzhes la// byad ma dgra bgegs gnod pa'i sbyor ba zlog /hūm̐/ sha khrag rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis// dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa 'di bzhes la// byad ma dgra bgegs gnod pa'i sbyor ba zlog

/hūm̐/ gdung sob lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// rig 'dzin slob dpon lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis// dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa 'di bzhes la// byad ma dgra bgegs gnod pa'i sbyor ba zlog /hūm̐/ dam rdzas rdza ltar lhag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis// dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa 'di bzhes la// byad ma dgra bgegs gnod pa'i sbyor ba zlog /hūm̐/ gtum drag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis// dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa 'di bzhes la// byad ma dgra bgegs gnod pa'i sbyor ba zlog /hūm̐/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor nas// tshom bu dgu yi bka' sdod 'khor bcas kyis// dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa 'di bzhes la// byad ma dgra bgegs gnod pa'i sbyor ba zlog /hūm̐ khroṃ bh+yo/ khro rgyal kun bzang che mchog he ru ka /dbu la sprul pa'i khyung chen 'bar bas brgyan// dgra bgegs gshed ma bya khyung rgyal po yis// ltas ngan zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod// hūm̐/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis// sman raka gtor ma'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bde gshegs bka' brgyad lha tshogs bden pa'i stobs// bden pa'i stobs kyis mi zlog gang yang med// nad gdon dgra bgegs ltas ngan zlog tu gsol// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+sha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi/ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti la khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta la khā hi/ hūm̐/ srid pa'i mdos chen da gtong na// steng dang phyogs mtshams sgo phyes la// sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha tshogs gshegs// chos kyi dbyings su lam bstan no/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/

bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ bh+yo/ re ma ti sogs srid pa'i lcam mo'i tshogs// rang rang ming po'i bka' sgyur khram kha zlogs/ khro rgyal mdung dmar can gyis dgra bgegs sgrol// dpal chen 'khor bcas dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs// bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ zlog zlog zlog /sa ma ya bh+yo/ hūm̐/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kun// bdud rtsi gser skyems 'di bzhes la// mdos dang zor gyi lam phyes shig /hūm̐/ dmar gyi gtor ma chen po 'dis// me rlung mtshon cha'i char pa 'bebs// dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs// oṃ pa ri shā ba ni mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhi khro bka' brgyad rol pa'i bros// ru dra dam sri rdul du rlogs// hūm̐ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ khro rol shin tu bsdus pa'i 'don bya 'di// rang gi rkyen zlog thugs dam bya phyir bris// nyes pa gang mchis bka' brgyad lha la bshags// dge bas byang chub sgrub la dge legs shog /rā ga a s+yes sbyar ba 'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
